# GeographicLib-C

This directory contains the standalone C geodesic implementation from
GeographicLib-C 2.2, pinned from the official `v2.2` tag:

https://github.com/geographiclib/geographiclib-c/tree/v2.2

Only the files required by qttest are vendored:

- `geodesic.c`
- `geodesic.h`
- `LICENSE.txt`
